The '''Jedi village''' was a settlement on the [[Temple Island]] of [[Ahch-To]] inhabited by early [[Jedi]].

==Description==
This settlement was constructed an unfathomable number of [[Standard year|years]] prior to [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]'s residence in the village, and consisted of ancient stone structures and cold huts that offered few comforts for their inhabitants. Skywalker himself made his home in a [[Luke's hut|hut]] in the village,<ref name="TLJ VD" /> and accommodated [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] in [[Rey's hut|another]] during her stay on the island. [[Caretakers]] of the [[Lanai]] also lived in and maintained the village huts.<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Jedi_village_TFA.png|thumb|300px|right|Rey enters the Jedi village in search of Luke Skywalker.]]
A small, modest village was founded on the [[Temple Island]] to house the first members of the [[Jedi Order]]. Thousands of years later, the Jedi village still stood, though it had been forgotten over time and through generations of [[Jedi Knight]]s and Masters. Despite the [[Jedi]]'s departure, the [[Caretakers]], who cared for the site, had not abandoned their mission and continued to maintain the huts in livable condition. Jedi Master Luke Skywalker had rediscovered the existence of the village while studying the Order's past.<ref name="Exegol" />

==Behind the scenes==
Scenes at the village were shot on location on the island of [[Wikipedia:Skellig Michael|Skellig Michael]] off the coast of Ireland, with the ruins of an ancient Christian monastery, once the home of Celtic Monks who lived as isolated hermits sheltered away from mainstream civilization, used to portray the temple.<ref name="Skellig">{{WebCite|url=http://www.irishtimes.com/culture/film/jj-abrams-can-t-believe-filming-allowed-on-skellig-michael-1.2484598|text=JJ Abrams 'can't believe' filming allowed on Skellig Michael|date=2016-01-04|archivedate=20190924074334}}</ref>
